title: [2D][PAID] Looking for Character Artist + Background Artist — Gothic Regency-Inspired Visual Novel
content: Hi! I'm looking for two artists for a gothic romance/mystery visual novel set in a fictional, Regency-inspired version of 19th-century London. Looking for expressive, stylized 2D character art (sprites, expressions, outfit variations) and atmospheric, painterly 2D backgrounds (country estates, gothic interiors, London streets). Both are paid commercial positions. Contact via itch.io thread or DM with portfolio, preferred role, rates, and turnaround time.
